# Northwind Studio Employee Handbook

Welcome to Northwind Studio. This handbook explains how we work, what you can expect from us, and what we expect from you. It applies to every employee, full time or part time, from your first day.

## Working hours

Core hours are 10am to 4pm, Monday to Friday. Outside core hours you choose when you work, as long as your team knows how to reach you.

The office is open from 7am to 8pm on weekdays. The office is closed on weekends and public holidays.

## Remote work

Employees can work remotely up to three days a week. Agree your remote days with your manager at the start of each month.

Northwind Studio pays a remote work allowance of $50 per month towards internet and home office costs.

## Paid time off

Full-time employees get 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays. Vacation days are accrued monthly and up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year.

Request vacation in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead. Requests for more than ten consecutive days need four weeks of notice.

## Sick leave

Sick leave is paid in full for up to 10 days per year. Tell your manager before 10am on the first day you are off sick.

A doctor's note is required for sick leave longer than 3 consecutive days.

## Parental leave

Parental leave is 16 weeks at full pay for every new parent, including adoptive parents. It can be taken any time in the first year after the birth or adoption.

You can return to work part time for up to 8 weeks after parental leave, at the same hourly rate.

## Expenses

Expenses are reimbursed within 10 business days of approval. Submit receipts in the finance app within 30 days of the purchase.

Travel must be booked through the company travel desk. Economy class is used for flights under 6 hours.

## Equipment

Every employee gets a laptop, a monitor and a headset on their first day. Equipment is replaced every 3 years, or sooner if it breaks.

Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours.

## Learning budget

Each employee has a learning budget of $1,200 per year for courses, books and conferences. Ask your manager to approve courses over $300 before you book them.

## Performance reviews

Performance reviews happen twice a year, in March and September. Salary reviews take place once a year, in March.

## Health benefits

Northwind Studio pays 90% of health insurance premiums for employees and 75% for their dependants. Coverage starts on your first day.

Dental and vision cover are included in the standard health plan. The plan year runs from January to December.

## Retirement plan

The company matches retirement contributions up to 5% of salary. Matching contributions vest after one year of employment.

## Onboarding

Your first week includes a welcome session, a security briefing and lunch with your team. Each new employee is paired with an onboarding buddy for their first 90 days.

The probation period is three months. Your manager meets you at the end of each month of probation to review how things are going.

## Security

Use the company password manager for every work account. Two-factor authentication is required on email, chat and the code repository.

Never share customer data outside the approved tools. Report suspected phishing emails to security@northwind.example.

## Office and guests

Guests must sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge. Employees can bring up to two guests at a time.

The kitchen is restocked every Monday and Thursday. Please label food you keep in the fridge; unlabelled food is cleared out on Fridays.

## Leaving the company

The notice period is one month for employees in their first year and two months after that. Return your laptop and badge on your last day.

## Contact

Questions about this handbook go to people@northwind.example. The people team answers within two business days.
